description: Places around a surf town, sorted by distance: stay (Places to stay), coffee (Coffee), food (Food & drinks), surf (Surf shops & schools), spots (Surf spots (community mapped)). Stays are a saved, merged OpenStreetMap + Overture Maps collection (hotels, resorts, hostels, surf camps, guesthouses, homestays, B&Bs, holiday rentals, villas, camping) with website, phone, email, socials, stars, rooms and facilities where known. Cafés, food and surf shops/schools are a saved Overture Maps collection too; community-mapped surf spots are a live OpenStreetMap lookup. Places with a reviewed, freely licensed photo (Wikimedia Commons) include it as photo { url, page, author, license }.

kind.description: Only one kind of place, e.g. stay: "surf_camp", "hostel", "homestay"; coffee: "cafe", "bakery"; food: "restaurant", "bar"; surf: "school", "shop".
